property_summary: For any caller address and any prior sequence, calling Initialized() on the correct contract always succeeds and leaves the public bool intitalized true (i.e. the call does not revert and intitalized becomes true); the mutant that never resets locked_ can cause subsequent nonReentrant_ calls (like Initialized) to revert for some caller sequences/inputs, so there exists fuzzed inputs that make Initialized() fail on the mutant but always succeed on the reference.
change_summary: Replace nonReentrant_ modifier to omit resetting locked_ = false after function execution (locks contract permanently after first use).
